faqs.a: True redaction destroys the underlying data. Many tools only draw a black rectangle over text that can still be copied underneath. This tool re-renders each page as an image with the matches burned in, then rebuilds the PDF — the original text layer is gone.

redact-pdf.formula:
for each page: render at 2x → for each match: draw black rect → rebuild page from image

Box geometry: x = match_x − 0.4×font, y = baseline − 1.4×font, w = text_width + 0.8×font, h = 1.55×font.
Result: output PDF contains 0 selectable characters — redaction is structural, not cosmetic.
howTo: Upload the PDF you want to sanitize (up to 50 MB).
Type the words or phrases to redact, separated by commas or new lines.
Choose case-sensitive matching only if you need exact case.
Click redact and wait while every page is scanned and rebuilt.
Download the sanitized PDF — the matches are permanently blacked out.
keyFacts: Redaction here is structural: each page is rasterized at 2x, matches are burned in as black rectangles, and the PDF is rebuilt from the images.
Because the rebuilt pages are images, the output has no text layer at all — redacted content cannot be selected, copied or searched.
Matching is substring-based and finds every occurrence on every page, with a per-term count shown afterwards.
Black boxes are padded by 40% of the font size on each side so no character slivers peek out.
The pdf.js reader is bundled with the site; the document itself never leaves your browser.

limitations: The output PDF has no selectable text at all — that is what makes redaction real, but it also means you cannot copy any remaining text.
Handwritten or scanned text cannot be found by text search, so it will not be redacted.
Phrases split across separate text runs inside the PDF may occasionally be missed.
Very large PDFs (100+ pages) can be slow to process and may use significant browser memory.

redact-pdf.workedExample:
A 10-page contract contains the term 'Aadhaar' 14 times.
Each page renders at 2x: about 1191 × 1684 px per A4 page.
The tool finds all 14 matches and burns in 14 black boxes (padded by 0.4 × font size).
The rebuilt 10-page PDF contains 0 selectable characters — the 14 occurrences are structurally gone.
